meta.name: lark-workflow-meeting-summary
meta.description: 会议纪要整理工作流：汇总指定时间范围内的会议纪要并生成结构化报告。当用户需要整理会议纪要、生成会议周报、回顾一段时间内的会议内容时使用。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按时间段汇总会议纪要并生成结构化报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常需整理团队会议记录并定期产出摘要
copy.tagline_en: Summarize meeting notes into a structured report for a time range
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to compile meeting notes into reports

howto.what: 按你给的时间范围查询会议，逐场取到纪要文档和逐字稿链接，整理成「今日会议概览」或「会议纪要周报」；你要求时还能把报告生成云文档。
howto.when: 当你要求整理会议纪要、生成会议周报或回顾某段时间的会议内容时触发；仅支持 user 身份，需先授权 vc，读正文和生成文档还要 drive。

say.text: 帮我整理这周的会议纪要
say.note: 默认汇总本周会议，逐场列出纪要链接
按单日格式输出今日会议概览

say.text: 把过去 7 天的会议纪要生成一份云文档
say.note: 调用文档技能生成汇总文档

howto.what_en: Queries your meetings for a given time range, pulls each meeting's notes and transcript links, and builds a structured report (daily overview or weekly digest); on request it can create a cloud doc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to organize meeting notes, produce a weekly meeting report, or review meetings over a period. User identity only; vc auth required (drive too for note bodies and doc creation).

say_en.text: Organize this week's meeting notes for me
say_en.note: Summarizes this week's meetings with note links

say_en.text: What meetings did I have yesterday?
Turn the past 7 days of meeting notes into a cloud doc
